A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] served as a '''soldier''' in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
The soldier first appeared in the first chapter of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', a [[2015]] expansion to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a massively-mulitplayer online game developed by [[BioWare]]. In the game, the soldier appears as a non-player character only identified as "Imperial Soldier".<ref name="Chapter 1" />
